detail.longDescription: A new version of the web management system I’ve been developing for those who believe that building for the web shouldn’t mean carrying unnecessary complexity. Opus Core was born out of a real need: to have a foundation of my own, with control over the code, freedom to develop, and an architecture that makes it possible to build solutions without imposing unnecessary tools and conventions. Version 1.2 is another step forward in that evolution. The goal isn’t to do everything for you. It’s to provide a foundation on which you can build what you actually need. Your own code. Freedom to develop. Fewer constraints and restrictions, more control. Opus Core 1.2 ‿︵ Your next idea starts with the foundation. Explore the project: https://github.com/wellingtonpragidi/opuscore https://opuscore.dev
